title: Introduce "Harmonizer" integration for INT8 weight-only profiles and golden-delta audit
creator: Jonas Rivera
description: Goal: Build an integration layer (Harmonizer) that unifies weight-only INT8 quantization profiles produced by GPTQ and AWQ tooling, exercises them through the regression harness, and runs a golden-answer delta audit across representative workloads. This ticket covers engineering work to ingest multiple profile formats, apply profile selection rules, run end-to-end accuracy validation, and produce a regression signal for rollout gating. Deliverables: Harmonizer ingestion adapters, CI job, telemetry mappings, golden-delta audit runner, and a short mitigation runbook.
acceptance_criteria: Harmonizer accepts GPTQ and AWQ profile artifacts and normalizes them to a canonical schema
A nightly CI job runs 3 representative models (MPT-7B, Llama-2-13B, Falcon-40B) with 4 profile variants and emits per-profile answer-deltas and numeric drift metrics
Golden-delta audit produces a ranked list of prompts with highest semantic divergence and stores artifacts to S3/drive
Regression gate threshold: average semantic-score drop <= 0.015 and 95th percentile token delta <= 2 for rollout to canary
Telemetry emits profile_id, profile_source, model_variant, kernel_config, failure_mode, and numeric_drift tags to the profiling pipeline
Runbook added with steps for rollback, shadowing, and canary laddering in Console
implementation_steps: Design canonical profile schema and mapping table (fields: quant_backend, per_layer_scales, clip_ranges, kernel_hints)
Implement GPTQ adapter to extract per-tensor scale/zero params and store in canonical JSON
Implement AWQ adapter (authoritative) and reconcile differences where AWQ uses asymmetric per-channel clipping
Add profile selection policy in runtime config: prefer AWQ profiles for GPU-narrow kernels, fallback to GPTQ when AWQ missing
Integrate Harmonizer into regression CI: new job (reg-quant-harmonizer) that spins test harness with synthetic traffic and golden prompt suite
Wire telemetry tags into metrics exporter and ensure traces include profile_id + kernel_version
Create golden-delta audit runner that computes embedding-based semantic-similarity (USE-512 baseline) and token-delta histograms
Add automated report artifact Uploader to S3 and link to PR description via pipeline
Author mitigation runbook (rollback PR, revert profile mapping, enable fp8-backstop) and validate via runbook walkthrough
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: AWQ and GPTQ rounding semantics differ causing apparent regressions. Mitigation: add normalization layer and numeric-tolerance mapping per-model.
Risk: Kernel swaps in heterogeneous fleet change perf/accuracy. Mitigation: tag runs with kernel_version and run kernel-swap stress tests in CI.
Risk: Golden prompts may be low-diversity leading to false negatives. Mitigation: expand suite with multilingual and instruction-following prompts from production-sampled telemetry.
Risk: CI runtime costs increase. Mitigation: limit nightly to 3 models + sampled prompt subsets and enable incremental runs on changed profiles only.
notes: This ticket is intentionally scoped to the engineering integration and audit tooling. PM/Design follow-ups for Console UX will be added as separate tickets.
We will reuse the existing quant-profile-registry s3 layout and add /harmonizer/v1/ manifests to avoid breaking older consumers.
Consider adding a lightweight confidence score per-profile that combines numeric drift and historical SLA impact (future work).
